core_categories: Pharmaceutical Distribution; Wholesale; Consumer Health Products; Logistics Services; Advisory Services
specialty_focus: Oriola is a Nordic health and wellbeing company specializing in the safe and reliable distribution, wholesale, and lifecycle advisory of pharmaceuticals, medicines, and consumer health products across Finland and Sweden. It acts as a principal distributor connecting global pharmaceutical manufacturers and health product suppliers with pharmacies, hospitals, and veterinarians, providing GDP-compliant logistics, cold-chain handling, vaccine distribution, and regulatory compliance advisory. Oriola does not specifically deal in wearable medical devices.
